name: git-file-write-options-reconciled
body:
Every granted git verb operates read-only on the repository: `--output=<file>` is forbidden on `git diff *`, `git log *`, and every other granted git verb, so their output reaches stdout only. The opencode bash grant surface is a prefix/glob form with zero negation, so a pattern that selects `git log *` while excluding `--output=<file>` is inexpressible; the forbidden form is enforced as prose, the same way the `git rebase *` worktree-only rule is enforced.

`opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` grants `git status *`, `git diff *`, `git log *`, `git branch --show-current`, `git worktree list *`, and a worktree-bounded `git rebase *`, and states the forbidden `--output=<file>` form. `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` grants `git log *` and states the same forbidden form. `git diff`/`git log` output goes to stdout only. `requirements.constraint.main-integration-via-merge-gate-only`, `requirements.constraint.agent-changes-always-on-main`, the navigator's main-git requirement, and `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-main-flow` carry this rule.
